chunks: He said, 'And it is reported that one should not pray Salat upon the head, when it is isolated from the body'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing funeral prayer on a separated head?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi highlights the juristic principle that the head, when separated, is treated as an independent entity for the purpose of funeral prayer, yet distinct from the main body's ritual status. Scholars note this reflects the holistic view of the human form in Shia fiqh, where the integrity of the corpse determines the applicability of specific burial rites. It underscores the precision with which early Imams addressed fragmented remains in practical legal scenarios.
